story.title: Rainy evening
paragraphs_en: Raju and his friends went out to play. They saw thick, dark clouds floating in the sky. It was suppose to rain heavily.
Soon it started raining. Showers were heavy with wild winds.
Raju's grandma called him back home. But Raju neglected her.
They started playing happily in rain. They danced in rain. They made paper boats and watched them float.
While returning home, they noticed people walking with umbrellas and raincoats. Everyone was protecting themself from rain.
When he returned home , mother asked Raju why didnot return when grand ma called. Raju said he wanted to play in rain, as it was really fun.

Mother wiped Raju and changed his cloths.She made him wear warm clothes.She told him it's not good to play in rain, as he may catch cold and fall sick. If he falls sick then he will miss so many things,
like playing with his friends in the evening, eating whatever he wishes. Moreover it will be uncomfortable also for him. She prepared hot soup for Raju.
Raju realized his mistake. He apologized mother for not listening to grand ma's calling. He hugged mother and said, he will never do it again.
